answer: One-shot terrain hash: each agent submits a SHA-3 digest of a one-time laser-etched jade wafer before its first on-chain call. The mesh rejects any duplicate whose digest sits within Hamming-8 of a prior entry, re-verifying serial imprints each tide cycle. Per identity, the attacker pays to fabricate, ship, and register a distinct knoll-patterned ceramic wafer, about fourteen dollars.
